# extended LDIF
#
# LDAPv3
# base <> with scope baseObject
# filter: (objectClass=*)
# requesting: namingContexts 
#

#
dn:
namingContexts: dc=example,dc=org

===LOG===

observation.command: su - dev -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && docker exec ddev-tfm-fachplanung-openldap ldapsearch -x -H ldap://localhost -b "" -s base "(objectClass=*)" namingContexts 2>&1 | head -12; echo "===LOG==="; ddev logs -s openldap 2>&1 | grep -E "Add custom|ldapadd|adding new entry|already_exists|error|ERROR" | head -20'
